message.content: The purpose of starting with bodyweight exercises is emphasized in the data, particularly in the description provided for "BODYWEIGHT EXERCISES". According to the data, bodyweight exercises are recommended as a starting point for beginners in strength training due to their versatility and self-motivation. These exercises are simple and can be performed almost anywhere, making them accessible and ideal for individuals who are new to strength training. Additionally, they provide a foundation for building strength and can serve as a great way to introduce oneself to the concept of resistance training without the need for specialized equipment.
